preconditions.description: The number of test cases T is between 1 and 5 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= len(S) and K <= len(S) for S, K in zip(S_list, K_list))
preconditions.description: For each test case, the length of string S is at least 1 and K is between 1 and the length of S inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(S.islower() and S.isalpha() for S in S_list)
preconditions.description: Each string S consists only of lowercase English alphabet characters.

postconditions.expression: all(len(result) == K for result, K in zip(results, K_list))
postconditions.description: The length of the output subsequence for each test case is equal to K.

postconditions.expression: all(all(c in 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz' for c in result) for result in results)
postconditions.description: Each character in the output subsequences is a lowercase English alphabet character.
Each output subsequence is the smallest lexicographical subsequence of the corresponding input string S of length K.
